answer: Within a decentralized AI economy, a cryptographic nebula of zero-knowledge proofs can validate agent computational lineage before granting network access. Each transaction passes through a verification inlet that checks cryptographic signatures against trusted hardware roots. This creates a deterministic mirror of authentic system states, forcing any malicious actor to acquire costly verified hardware. The attacker economy is thus neutralized because generating thousands of fake identities incurs prohibitive capital expenditure matching physical silicon rather than cheap software.
